title: 12th Sitting of first Session of 2025
summary: The 12th sitting (10:31 to 11:04) was short. Members heard written answers from Foreign Minister Dr. Abdulla Khaleel to three questions from the North Galolhu member, covering foreign service staffing, the ban on Israeli passports and the Foreign Secretary's appointment. An urgent motion on repeated power cuts in Addu City failed to get enough votes to be debated (13 yes, 47 no). The Speaker sent three presidential nominations to the Foreign Relations Committee and a request to remove a Broadcasting Commission vice president to the Independent Institutions Committee. The attendance line for official travel has no readable number in the text.

speakers.name: Mohamed Ibrahim
positions: Asked how many Foreign Service staff are political appointees given the 20% legal cap, and what the actual figure is.
Asked why the June 2024 decision to bar Israeli passports from entering the Maldives has not been carried out.
Asked whether the Foreign Secretary meets the legal requirement of ten years' ministry experience.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Nazil
positions: Moved an urgent motion on repeated power cuts in Addu City, citing broken generators, missing spare parts and unmet government promises.

decisions: Minutes of the 7th to 9th sittings accepted as no amendments were submitted.
Urgent motion on Addu City power cuts not accepted for debate (13 yes, 47 no, 0 abstain; 60 voted).
UN ESCAP permanent representative nomination sent to the Foreign Relations Committee.
Two non-resident ambassador nominations (Spain and New Zealand) sent to the Foreign Relations Committee.
Request to remove Broadcasting Commission vice president Mohamed Fazeen sent to the Independent Institutions Committee.
Next sitting announced for Tuesday 11 March 2025 at 10:30.
